filtering_and_labeling_audit.note: train.py expands PD from 28 explicit QUESTDB tags to 75 by also tagging unlabeled states with 50% <= %T1 < 85% as PD; GD remains strictly 28/28.

theorem_5_code_audit_caveat.finding: src/lehmann_tddft/theorems.py constructs a parametric 1-loop Hamiltonian (explicitly setting H_SS[0,0]=e_s0+xg and V[0,:]=4*yh*v_dir) to verify the algebraic block-matrix Theorem 5 identity (R=0.99999, overlap=-0.99987). The manuscript MUST distinguish this algebraic proof from the real ab initio molecular conical intersection grids (Ethylene, Methanimine, Fulvene, PSB3) in Pillar 4.

zero_oracle_vs_hungarian_GD_audit.referee_caveat: Because H_full contains up to 96 bi-exciton basis states, finding at least one eigenstate with %T2>=40% (100% GD_detection_rate) is structurally guaranteed whenever doubles are enabled. Real predictive power is proven by (1) zero-oracle MAE dropping 3.42x vs bare bi-exciton poles (0.691 vs 2.367 eV; 0.527 eV excl. C2), (2) Hungarian-matched MAE = 0.487 eV (0.504 eV excl. C2) beating Static-Delta (1.090 eV), ADC(3) (0.904 vs 0.529 eV matched, n=23), and CCSD (2.494 vs 0.342 eV matched, n=3), and (3) %T1 character MAE = 4.72% vs uncoupled poles (0%/100%).

Double_Hybrid_TDDFT_structural.note: Perturbative CIS(D) double-hybrid TD-DFT corrects existing single-excitation roots but emits 0 genuine double-excitation eigenstates.

ethylene_ci_perturbative_breakdown.conclusion: Perturbative DH-TDDFT (B2PLYP / SCS-PBE-QIDH) inherits Brillouin's theorem (H_01 = 0 identically), plunges to unphysical negative excitation energies across the S1/S0 crossing, and cannot form a conical double cone or nonzero Berry phase (gamma = 0).

lomo_zero_manual_beta_transfer.guardrail: Use `scalar` LOMO/Ethylene-only head (0 manual beta: 6/6 single-mol & 3/3 LOMO exact gamma=pi, 0 neg gaps, 6/6 & 3/3 0pi controls, Fulvene 2shMAE=0.085 eV) as primary Pillar 4 v2.0 operator; legacy beta=0.35 in fulvene_ci_summary.json under-couples Fulvene with v2.0 checkpoints (min_ov=0.030).

fssh_2d_branching_plane_dynamics.framing_guardrail: Accurately describe as 2D branching-plane Tully FSSH with EDC decoherence (300 trajectories, 50 fs, reflecting box boundaries), NOT full-3N-6 on-the-fly AIMD.
